title: An element of a generated subfield lies in the subfield generated by finitely many of the generators
statement: Let $F/E_0$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], with $E_0\subseteq F$, and let $S\subseteq F$ be a subset. Write $E_0(S)$ for the smallest subfield of $F$ containing $E_0$ and $S$ (the intersection of all subfields of $F$ containing $E_0$ and $S$). Then for every $z\in E_0(S)$ there is a finite subset $S_0\subseteq S$ with $z\in E_0(S_0)$.
